method: Source-diff review of the five gallery-interface files this PR changes, after migration 20260926150000 (photo_metadata.alt_text) was applied to production and confirmed readable through the anon client. Visible change: the generated caption paragraph is removed from /photo/[id], PhotoDetailModal and Lightbox (Nino: generated text should not be shown as if written). Non-visible change: prefers photo_metadata.alt_text, falling back to the previous caption/title-based alt when null (every row is null until the backfill runs, so rendered alt is unchanged at deploy). No new copy, labels or messages were added. A live walk of a production /photo/[id] page follows the deploy.
